dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-to-upper flank exhibit light-colored interior pixels with a defined high-contrast transition to the surrounding dark fur; edges are generally smooth and elliptical.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity solid light clusters are distributed with low density, appearing primarily as small, asymmetrical dots near the cervical region and scattered along the lower lateral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct triangular geometry is formed by the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli located on the upper dorsal-lateral quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of interconnected, semi-circular light-intensity lines creates a chain-like texture across the central posterior region.
